tasks.title: First-write-wins shutdown request and deadline
acceptance_conditions: The handler's first state-mutating operation uses preallocated state to attempt one atomic first-write-wins claim. The winning signal publishes one immutable shutdown request and absolute monotonic deadline without locks, logging, Event access, or dependency I/O; later signals cannot replace it.

tasks.title: Shutdown dispatch linearization
acceptance_conditions: Pre-request dispatch transactions are bounded in-flight work and no Kafka, Schema Registry, or reconciliation transaction entering after the request can submit.

tasks.title: Shutdown-aware Kafka log-handler lifecycle
acceptance_conditions: Kafka log-handler registration is rejected or immediately disarmed after shutdown, and interpreter logging cleanup cannot extend the absolute deadline.

tasks.title: Startup and runtime deadline abandonment
acceptance_conditions: Startup and runtime execute behind an abandonable daemon boundary and partial cleanup never extends the original shutdown deadline.

tasks.title: Authoritative liveness state snapshot
acceptance_conditions: HealthStateStore publishes an immutable concurrency-safe liveness snapshot derived only from monotonic scheduler-heartbeat age, shutdown state, and bounded fatal-internal state; Kafka and Schema Registry observations cannot affect it.

tasks.title: Runtime liveness-state publication and configuration
acceptance_conditions: Runtime configuration validates the positive finite scheduler-heartbeat threshold, the control loop publishes monotonic heartbeats, shutdown becomes observable without signal-handler dependency work, and fatal internal or reconciliation termination is recorded before exit.

tasks.title: Startup dependency dispatch authorization
acceptance_conditions: Every startup Kafka, Schema Registry, and reconciliation dependency operation is submitted to an abandonable daemon lane through the shared shutdown dispatch guard; only authorization and executor submission occur inside the guard, native work runs outside it, and remaining startup stages abort after shutdown rejects submission. Startup execution uses a dedicated factory seam distinct from runtime Kafka executors.

tasks.title: Replacement-runtime dispatch authorization
acceptance_conditions: After reconciliation completes, replacement Kafka consumer construction is authorized and submitted through the shared shutdown dispatch guard to an abandonable daemon lane, native construction runs outside the guard, and a shutdown request that wins before authorization skips reconstruction and proceeds to cleanup without creating Kafka clients.
